up: Retrieve up to 1000 activity rows for IC50 measurements against the human single-protein target CHEMBL1293237 (RecQ-like DNA helicase BLM). For each row, return: assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax_id, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value. Only include rows where the standard relation is exactly '=' and the pChEMBL value is not null. Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID and then by assay ChEMBL ID. Limit the output to 1000 rows.
sql:
SELECT
    a.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
    td.target_type,
    td.tax_id,
    cs.canonical_smiles,
    a.molecule_chembl_id,
    a.standard_type,
    a.pchembl_value
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molecule_chembl_id = cs.molecule_chembl_id
WHERE
    td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1293237'
    AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
    AND a.standard_relation = '='
    AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
    a.molecule_chembl_id,
    a.chembl_id
LIMIT 1000;
